name: TigerVespamon
main_effect:
＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] For each of your face up security cards, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, none of their Digimon can unsuspend until the end of their turn.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When other Digimon are deleted in battle, this Digimon may unsuspend.
